usedFor: Shopify holds orders, and Autobound writes a personal email when “New Order” runs “Write Hyper-Personalized Email”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Write Hyper-Personalized Email” in Autobound
bestTemplate.why: Each order gives Autobound a real customer to write to, so the email fits that purchase.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so any email written from it follows after a scheduled check.
